label: Retinal pigment epithelium
explanation: Pigmented epithelial border on the choroidal side; distinct from choroidal melanocytes.

label: Photoreceptor segments
explanation: Specialised parts of rods and cones facing the RPE; their nuclei lie in a different named layer.

label: External limiting zone
explanation: Junction-associated boundary involving photoreceptors and Müller glia; not a standalone cell layer.

label: Outer nuclear layer
explanation: Photoreceptor nuclei; a dense band in the supplied detail.

label: Outer plexiform layer
explanation: Processes and synaptic contacts involving photoreceptors and receiving/lateral cells.

label: Inner nuclear layer
explanation: Mixed neuronal and Müller-glial cell bodies; not a pure bipolar-cell population.

label: Inner plexiform layer
explanation: Process-rich region containing bipolar, amacrine and ganglion-cell connections.

label: Ganglion-cell layer
explanation: Ganglion-cell bodies and additional cell populations; nuclear appearance alone does not classify every cell.

label: Nerve-fibre layer
explanation: Ganglion-cell axons running toward the optic disc; thickness depends on region.

label: Internal limiting membrane
explanation: Vitreous-facing basement-membrane boundary associated with Müller endfeet.
